versions.changelog:
Personality Distiller 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Automatically distills names, vague requirements, links, existing Skills, or local corpora into a complete Agent persona file pack.
- Supports five entry types: Named Person, Fuzzy Requirement, Web Link, Existing Skill, and Local Corpus.
- Deep research and framework extraction workflows with confirmation steps.
- Generates and overwrites all six key persona files using templates.
- Includes a quality checklist and anti-patterns to ensure distinct, thorough personas.
